card.name: B of BCG and health before care
card.fires_on: The capital B that starts BCG (the vaccine) in vaccine lists, and the word health or Health starting the phrase health care provider/professional.

modes.label: B in BCG
modes.description: The letter B that begins BCG, in lists of live vaccines or tuberculosis skin-test text.
modes.example: intranasal influenza, measles, mumps, rubella, oral polio,<< B>>CG, yellow fever, varicella

modes.label: health before care
modes.description: The word health (or Health) just before care provider or care professional, often at the start of a sentence or after a comma.
modes.example: who take PPIs with medications such as digoxin or drugs that may cause hypomagnesemia (e.g., diuretics),<< health>> care professionals may consider monitoring magnesium levels prior

card.writes: It pushes the model toward health or healthcare as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the B of BCG vaccine and on the word health when it opens health care provider.
